evidence: queue or Redis dependency appears without a matching stack decision
background job package exists but no async work owner is documented
rules.remediation: Record why the queue/cache dependency is needed and which simpler options were rejected.

evidence: retryable external side effect has no idempotency key
worker catches errors without retry or failed-job behavior
rules.remediation: Add idempotency, retry, and failure behavior before treating the async path as durable.

evidence: worker or scheduler exists without local-dev command
Redis, queue, or workflow dependency lacks production ownership notes
rules.remediation: Document local development, production ownership, failure handling, and proof gates.
